data.title: Senior Sales Manager – SAP EWM & Tech Solutions
data.description:
Your Responsibilities

- You are responsible for steering the sales cycle – from initial contact through strategic tenders to final closing.
- You position our entire portfolio of SAP EWM projects, consulting services, and innovative automation products in a customer-specific manner.
- Through clever lead qualification, tailored presentations, and webinars, you build a sustainable, strong deal pipeline.
- As a valued sparring partner, you negotiate confidently directly with IT leaders, logistics heads, and management.
- A watchful eye on market and competition gives you the decisive advantage with customers.

Your Profile

- 5+ years of B2B sales in the SAP logistics or software environment.
- Process knowledge around intralogistics and a high affinity for SAP technologies (EWM, S/4HANA, Fiori) set you apart.
- Your working style is defined by absolute closing strength, pronounced initiative, and the stamina that complex sales cycles require.
- Confident negotiation skills in German and English at decision-maker level are second nature to you.

What Awaits You

**High-Impact Portfolio:**

An established brand with top references and products that deliver real efficiency gains for customers.

**Maximum Autonomy:**

Full ownership of your pipeline and the freedom to drive deals to success independently.

**No Bullshit:**

Short decision paths, flat hierarchies, and a strong team behind you that delivers on what you promise in sales.

**Your Benefits:**

- Permanent employment contract
- Comprehensive onboarding program
- Active involvement in shaping your professional future
- Perfect work-life balance through flexible work(time) models
- Targeted, individual development opportunities
- FlexBike: Bike leasing
- Centrally located office with excellent transport connections
- FlexFit: Activity offers & wellness pass
- Sports with your favorite colleagues
- Perfect, ergonomic workspace
- Shared events that are really fun
- Corporate benefits where you can really save
- Occupational pension scheme
- Grill & smoker on our sunny terrace
- Free parking spaces
- Vehicles for external appointments and business trips
- Solutions for mobile working from home office
- Secure workplace in THE dynamic industry of the future
- Regular feedback that really helps you progress

About Us

**Since the founding of FLEXUS AG, we have dedicated ourselves to perfecting our customers' logistics processes.**

With currently around 100 employees, we work every day to significantly rationalize, simplify, and optimize our customers' material flow, thus taking their internal logistics processes to a new level. Through our holistic approach combining consulting, implementation, and add-ons, we are the perfect partner for our national and international customers when it comes to the successful implementation and support of SAP EWM S/4HANA projects.

data.description:
- Location:-, Berlin
- Type:Permanent

**VP, Sales – France**

**Based anywhere in France, with frequent travel to Berlin (French Speaking)**

Our client is an early-stage fintech built by a founding team with a proven track record — having previously scaled a European payments business to over 100 employees across 17 markets before a successful nine-figure exit — and is currently seeking a French speaking VP, Sales to lead the French market. The role can be based anywhere in France, with frequent travel to the company's Berlin base required during the first year.

The company operates a platform connecting prepaid product brands directly with enterprise clients, covering gift cards, airtime and eCash under a single API. The ideal candidate will be responsible for owning the French market from day one, working directly with one of the founders on strategy and commercial execution.

**Responsibilities as a VP, Sales:**

**As a VP, Sales, you will work closely with the founding team. Your day-to-day tasks will contain:**

- Owning the full business development cycle — from initial outreach through demos, negotiation and close.
- Building and managing a focused pipeline of high-value enterprise partnerships, targeting approximately 5-6 strategic deals per year.
- Identifying and engaging partners with the potential to generate €10M+ in annual turnover per relationship.
- Navigating complex B2B sales cycles of up to six months, managing multiple stakeholders across each opportunity.
- Developing tailored commercial propositions aligned to partner needs across sectors including banking, retail, HR & payroll, crypto and consumer brands.
- Representing the business at industry events, partner meetings and on-site visits across Europe, with two to three trips per month.
- Travelling frequently to Berlin during the first year to work closely with the founding team, with the expectation of greater location flexibility as the role and market mature.
- Working closely with the founder on deal structuring and strategic commercial decisions.
- Gathering and feeding back market intelligence to sharpen the company's partnership strategy and growth roadmap.

**Qualifications/Required Skills for an ideal VP, Sales:**

**An ideal candidate for the VP, Sales role will need to meet most of these requirements:**

- Experienced in enterprise or strategic B2B sales, ideally within fintech, payments or a related industry.
- Comfortable managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with patience and discipline.
- Commercially sharp, able to structure deals, negotiate confidently and close with conviction.
- Fluent in French and English to a professional business standard.
- Resilient and self-motivated, with the persistence to push through extended cycles and repeated rejection without losing momentum.
- Hungry to build — looking to create a playbook, not manage an existing one.
- Highly organised and capable of operating independently in an early-stage environment.
- A genuine relationship builder who wins trust through substance, not just charm.
- Willing and able to travel frequently to Berlin, particularly during the first year.

**Interested? Get in touch now!**
